title: Classic Algerian Chickpea Tagine
description: A hearty and comforting stew originating from Algeria, made with chickpeas and aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: Warm olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality, extra virgin olive oil

ingredients.name: Fatty lamb or beef
ingredients.notes: Cut into 1-inch cubes, use boneless cuts

ingredients.name: Chickpea tagine spice blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern or North African markets

instructions: Heat the warm olive oil in a large clay or ceramic dish over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger, cook for an additional minute.
Add the lamb or beef, cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, and chickpea tagine spice blend, stir to combine.
Add the chickpeas, stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, reduce heat to low, and cook for 30 minutes, or until the meat is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
